title: Pan-Seared Cod with Salad
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared cod served with a fresh salad.

ingredients.name: Velvety sauce
ingredients.notes: A creamy sauce to complement the cod

ingredients.name: Norwegian seasoning
ingredients.notes: A blend of herbs and spices

instructions: Season cod fillets with Norwegian seasoning.
Add Peppery oil to the skillet and sear the cod for 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the cod from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add salad greens and toss with salad dressing.
Place the cooked cod on top of the salad.
Drizzle Velvety sauce over the cod and salad.
